using KernelInterface

function kernel!(out::AbstractVector{Float32}, x::AbstractVector{Float32}, n::Int32)
    for i in 1:n
        idx = KI.get_global_id().x
        neighbor1 = x[max(i-1, 1)]
        neighbor2 = x[i]
        neighbor3 = x[min(i+1, n)]
        out[idx] = (neighbor1 + neighbor2 + neighbor3) / 3.0f0
    end
end
